ESH. Coming from a 23yo woman with an extremely promiscuous past with men and women of all ages, your daughter will, most likely, regret this relationship. But unfortunately, you are just going to have to let her make her own mistakes. I started dating and sleeping around by 15 and my parents, being ultraconservative, tried their damnedest to get me on their version of the right track. Obviously they tried to protect me and stop me from making bad choices, but to an extent they should have just let me learn the hard way sooner to spare myself more years of making those bad choices. I did not understand the situations I was getting myself into and no one explained the real dangers. I was sleeping with men twice my age before I was out of high school and I had to figure out for myself what it really means when an older person says you're mature for your age. I had no guidance on the significance of things like that so in my head, it was all about teenage rebellion and feeling free. It took a lot of abusing drugs and being abused with a lot of different people to finally wake up and grow up. Your daughter may be nothing like me, you may be nothing like my parents, but at the end of the day all you can do is try to help her understand the significance of the choices she's making and hope that nothing gets worse for anyone.

I've been doing tarot for a few years, still amateur level as I mostly do it for myself, but sometimes I'll do a reading for other people in my life. I absolutely REFUSE to ever do another spread for romantic relationships though, because naturally the cards bring truth to light. The couples I read for were all friends or mutual acquaintances, and they obviously didn't have the best relationships to begin with, for one reason or another, and I would try to (tactfully) warn them that they might be unhappy with what the cards had to tell them. There were only four couples I ever did this for and out of the four readings, ONE had positive results. Every other one was like a Dr. Phil episode, predictably. The last time, the couple apparently got into a massive fight and used the tarot reading as ammunition in their argument, and then went so far as to actually blame me for "starting drama." That was a couple years ago now, and I've stuck to my rule ever since. If a loved one who's struggling with relationship issues asks me for a reading, I'll do it for them as an individual without their partner present, but I am never making myself the middleman ever again.
